_meta.currency_note: All amounts synthetic; INR unless stated; 2-dp half-even rounding at presentation only; internal arithmetic exact Decimal
_meta.status: Expected values hand-computed by author and re-verified by reference_calcs.py; this is NOT a test of an application that has not yet been built
_meta.precision: Storage NUMERIC(18,4); wire string decimal 4 dp; presentation ROUND_HALF_EVEN 2 dp; price floors ROUND_CEILING to minor unit
_meta.sign_convention: P&L line inputs carry sign (costs negative) and are summed; register/expense inputs named *_expenses/ad_spend/indirect_alloc are positive magnitudes and are subtracted
